## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, expected result and concrete change.

## Validation

List exact checks and outcomes. Separate compilation, model/mocked checks and
live hardware evidence. For display changes, include Windows scale, monitor,
connection and driver. Do not upload private settings or raw logs.

## Review

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves error handling, validation and author credit.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant regression checks match the resulting behavior.
- [ ] I read the current audit findings and did not claim unsupported safety or accessibility.
- [ ] I checked the pending source-license status before contributing for redistribution.

## Remaining limits

State what was not tested and any new risk.
